lines.text: Hey! ఆగండి… ఈ పిట్టకి తోక లేదు, రెక్కలు లేవు… కానీ ఊర్లు దాటుతుంది!
Answer చివర్లో ఉంది… చివరి వరకు చూడండి!
మన అమ్మమ్మలు చెప్పిన… ఒక పాత పొడుపు కథ!
తోకలేని పిట్ట… తొంభై ఆమడలు పోతుంది… ఏంటది?
lines.act: slow sing-song folk recitation, with feeling

lines.text: ఆమడ అంటే… పాతకాలపు దూరం కొలత. అంటే చాలా దూరం!
Clue one — ఇది మాట్లాడదు… కానీ మాటలు మోసుకెళ్తుంది!
కాదు! Aeroplane కి తోక ఉంది… పావురానికి కూడా!
Clue two — postman అన్నయ్యకి… ఇది బాగా తెలుసు!
ఇలాంటివి రోజూ కావాలంటే… follow చేయండి, YouTube లో subscribe!
Answer reveal అయ్యే ముందే… మీ answer comment లో పెట్టండి!

lines.act: dramatic pause, then a big joyful reveal

lines.text: తోక లేదు, రెక్కలు లేవు… అయినా మన మాటల్ని ఊర్లు దాటిస్తుంది!
మీ answer correct ఆ? Comment లో ✅ పెట్టండి!
lines.say: మీ answer correct ఆ? Comment లో tick పెట్టండి!

lines.text: ఈ riddle మీ friend కి share చేసి… వాళ్ళ knowledge check చేయండి! Follow… subscribe… రేపు ఇంకో twist!

visual_plan: style: NEON skin (const SKIN = "neon" in ep.html) — glow-sketch night look over the colony; text overlays stay crisp

hook: title 'పొడుపు కథ #4 🐦' + 'తోక లేదు… రెక్కలు లేవు!' pill; dark night sky over the colony rooftops, a small glowing bird-shaped light with no tail and no wings zips across from one side to the other, leaving a neon trail; Gopi on the terrace pointing up
hold: 'ANSWER AT THE END 👀' tag pops with a neon flicker
story: glowing chalk-line village houses and a winding road appear behind Gopi (nostalgic, soft glow)

riddle: the riddle text writes itself in neon on the night sky; the tailless glowing bird flies along the road while distance markers tick past — 10… 30… 60… 90 ఆమడలు — ending on a big glowing '90 ఆమడలు' milestone stone
riddle (ఆమడ aside): a small tag 'ఆమడ = పాత దూరం కొలత' with a long road stretching to the horizon (no km number shown)
clue 1: tag 'CLUE 1 💬'; the bird passes over a sleeping house and tiny glowing speech-bubble dots trail behind it (words being carried), the bird itself has no mouth
guess: a tap-to-guess poll slides up with 3 glowing options: '✈️ Aeroplane' / '🕊️ పావురం' / '❓' (the third card stays a mystery — no ✉️ yet); a hand icon taps Aeroplane (Pinky's pick)
no: red ✗ + buzzer on '✈️ Aeroplane' (a neon plane outline with its tail fin highlighted), then '🕊️ పావురం' also gets a ✗ (tail highlighted); only '❓' is left glowing
clue 2: tag 'CLUE 2 📮'; a glowing red post box on the colony street lights up and a cycle bell rings (no real logos or uniforms, a simple drawn post box)
follow: animated FOLLOW + SUBSCRIBE buttons glow and get tapped by a hand
comment-countdown: '💬 COMMENT NOW' + 5-second neon countdown clock (no voice during the 5 s); glowing comment bubbles pop up around the screen with guesses like '✈️?', '🕊️?', '🪁?', '🤔'
after-countdown: Pinky tugs Gopi's sleeve, hands together pleading
reveal: the tailless bird stops mid-sky and morphs into a glowing envelope (folded flap = 'wings' that were never there); confetti sparks, 'ANSWER ✅ ఉత్తరం!' banner; the poll's '❓' card flips to '✉️'
why: the envelope flies from one glowing village to another and drops into a house window; tiny neon letters float out of it to a smiling family silhouette (simple drawn, no real people)
twist: split screen — left a phone with a generic chat bubble icon (no app logo) 'ఇప్పుడు', right the glowing envelope 'అప్పట్లో'; the envelope winks
react: Pinky giggles and claps, sparkles around the envelope
share/close: share-arrow animation sends a mini envelope to a friend icon; end card FOLLOW @_REELRASAM · SUBSCRIBE @REEL_RASAM
